0022600127.text: Denver hosts Golden State with the Nuggets at 1-1 (1-0 at home, 0-1 on the road), on a W1 streak, sitting 4th in the Northwest, 1 game back, and 8th in the West. Golden State is 0-3 on a three-game losing streak, 5th in the Pacific, 3 games back, and 15th in the West. Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), with Alpha Diallo (wrist) and Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain) day-to-day and game-time decisions; Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), with Brandon Williams (back soreness), Charles Bassey (knee), and Gui Santos (knee tendinitis) day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after splitting 2-2 in 2025-26, and Denver's most recent meeting was a 116-93 win in Denver on March 29, 2026.
